#+title: Legacy contextual phase-library inputs

These are first-order test inputs, not SDK authority or qualified SDK products.
The actual immutable SDK /nix/store/xdb01wffh5c9fy6r7f2p9bpx3kfil91z-beam-lisp-sdk-selection
produced v2.etf and v2-twins.etf through expand/phase-library. Its known broader
qualification failures are unchanged; only fixture production is asserted here.

v2.etf contains base/v1 answer=42 and library/v1 importing answer, with result=42.
v1.etf derives from it by removing import-token origins, changing the format to1
and recomputing the data digest. v2-twins.etf contains identical provider Source
under a/z revisions and a.bl/z.bl origins. They deliberately retain old anonymous
world IDs so the current decoder must rebuild qualified identities, not merely
change a version number.

Producer: .local/execution/revision-legacy-fixtures1/{driver.bl,run.py,run.log}.
The tracked revision tests read these fixtures via BL_TEST_SOURCE_ROOT/cwd.
Preflight freezes .etf inputs, and final candidate source_digest includes them.
Regenerating through the current API would produce v3 and destroy the old-format
oracle. Keep these exact byte hashes:

- v2-twins.etf: 0549c7a88e0ea46e0ba87364e59bb1617486d8eb85b107820dbd519be1bf9d7e
